title: Add single activate_all_mcp_tools umbrella command
description: R3 from codebase audit tool-discovery audit. There are ~10 activate_* tools across different domains. A single command that activates all registered MCP tool groups at once would let the agent call one thing and know all tools are available. Granular activate_* tools would remain for power users. This is a VS Code extension / MCP host code change outside this repo.
